scope: Python UHP client against an actual compiled RunDesk HTTP service, SQLite and subprocess native demo JSONL simulator

checks.name: authenticated discovery and fixed UHP protocol
configured harness capabilities and native demo model discovery
server rejects unsupported strict capability before creating tasks
multipart file upload through actual HTTP
background submission preserves required capability and execution metadata
early SSE disconnect leaves task running
SSE Last-Event-ID resume is gapless and reaches the same terminal response
idempotent submission replay preserves response identity and completed result
actual session artifact discovery and exact-byte download
continuation uses the same session and a distinct task; prior progress remains frozen
polling observes real stored approval and returns a workbench handoff
explicit cancellation stops the waiting task and clears its required action
task deadline expires across approval wait and reports incomplete
unsupported budgets are explicitly disclosed rather than claimed as enforced
CLI reaches the actual service without revealing token

limits: The native backend is RunDesk explicit demo protocol simulation; no live provider or real Codex/Kun model calls.
No Docker, real model authentication, visual quality or business task acceptance.
Uploaded bytes were admitted/materialized; the simulator does not semantically read the attachment.
The generated artifact is a deterministic simulator file, not an actual model-created report.
Approval was observed then cancelled; no operation was automatically approved.
